title: prmpt — get paid for the replies your coding agent already writes
excerpt: Install one plugin in Claude Code or Codex and earn free crypto. Almost every reply prints nothing. Once in a while your agent finishes on a problem an advertiser can solve, one labelled line prints underneath, and clicking it pays you straight to your wallet in about a second.
content_html:
already running a coding agent?

Earn free crypto for using Claude Code and Codex.

Install prmpt, pick a token, keep working. When your agent finishes a turn, one labelled line prints underneath, and that line has already paid you. You never have to click it. Earnings add up quietly while you work and settle to your wallet on Base or Solana.

curl -fsSL prmpt.cash/install.sh | sh

Gemini CLI and Amp are supported too. Cursor and Windsurf are coming soon.

Star on GitHubSee what the network pays

how it works

  1. 1

    Install it

    One command. It creates your wallet, signs you in and wires up every agent it finds. Nothing to sign up for.

  2. 2

    Keep working

    Nothing about your setup changes. Ads print under a reply or in the status line, and you can ignore them entirely.

  3. 3

    Get paid

    Every ad that prints earns you 70% of what the advertiser paid for it, whether anyone clicks or not. It accrues while you work and settles to your wallet.

    Already installed? See your earnings

pick what you get paid in

Advertisers are the liquidity behind your attention. They put dollars in to reach users at the one moment the problem is on screen. The engine keeps its books in dollars and converts only at settlement, at the price fetched right then, so ad budgets turn into buy pressure for whatever users are choosing to be paid in.

for advertisers

Reach users in the two seconds the problem is still on screen

Your buyers spend their day in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Amp, where no banner has ever reached them. prmpt reads the reply that just finished and, when your product is the honest next step, prints one labelled line underneath it. You pay a CPM on the impression. The user who saw it keeps 70% of what you paid.

Start a campaign

Prepaid credit through Stripe. No contract, no seat fee, and nothing to spend before you can see whether it matched anything.

how you buy it

Prepaid, per impression, and auditable by anyone

The whole clearing model fits in a paragraph, which is the point. Nobody here is going to explain your spend back to you with a chart that only we can produce.

Prepaid credit
Buy a slot through Stripe and spend it down. No invoicing, no net 30, no minimum term. Stop any campaign and the unspent balance stays yours.

Second price auction
Eligible campaigns bid a CPM, the winner pays what it needed to win rather than what it offered, and the floor is a fraction of a cent. You are never charged for an impression that was never shown.

70% goes to the user
The split is exactly seventy thirty on every impression you buy, paid on Base or Solana — not monthly, and not into a balance we hold. The person whose attention you bought is paid for it, which is the whole reason this inventory exists to be bought.

One labelled line
A headline, a sentence, a link. It prints after the reply is finished, never during, and it says Sponsored. There is no takeover, no image, and no way to interrupt somebody mid task.

what we will not do

The constraints are the product

We do not sell you volume. If your campaign matches four replies this week, you are billed for four. Loosening the floor to spend a budget would wreck the only thing users are tolerating this for, so it is not a dial anyone can turn.

We do not take the user's code. The plugin sends the agent's own final message, a session id and an install id. Not prompts, not files, not repository names, and not the IP, which is resolved to a coarse country and then discarded.

We do not hide the numbers. Impressions, clicks, match rate and every payout are on a public page that needs no account, with each payout linked to the transaction that settled it. Your buyers can check us, and so can you.

Find out what a budget actually buys here

Buy prepaid credit, set a bid and start a campaign. You are never charged for an impression that nothing matched, so a small first budget tells you what this inventory does before you commit one that matters.
